goals: Implement the pure controller-owned EvidenceBundle v0 model and atomic writer in src/supervisor/evidence-bundle.ts with focused tests in tests/evidence-bundle.test.ts. Build a deterministic, bounded, credential-free bundle from a terminal RunManifest and validated repository facts. Include run/plan identity, terminal status, contracts and manifest hashes, base/integration commits, task verdicts, result commits, failures, cost truth, path audits, process-tree records, WorkspaceBoundary records, missing observations, humanReviewRequired and a bounded nextAction. Refuse running manifests; support completed, blocked and interrupted terminal states. Compute deterministic serialization and idempotent atomic writes under .cliyard/evidence/<runId>.json. Never copy prompts, transcripts, file contents, environment dumps or unbounded logs, never mutate a RunManifest and never grant acceptance or merge. Test success, terminal failure, missing required evidence, malformed manifest/input, path bounds, deterministic bytes, idempotent rewrite and no secret-bearing fields. Do not modify the Supervisor CLI, RunManifest schema or other source files.
nonGoals: Do not integrate the bundle into Supervisor commands in this task.
Do not change RunManifest authority or task acceptance.
Do not copy raw transcripts, prompts or file contents.
Do not claim EvidenceBundle replaces verification.
deliverables: A typed EvidenceBundle v0 builder and atomic writer.
Focused tests for terminal-state validation, bounded projection, determinism, idempotence and missing evidence.
forbidden: Do not claim Bundle creation changes acceptance.
Do not persist secrets or raw provider payloads.
Do not edit files outside writePaths.

goals: Implement the deterministic Harness Eval v0 engine in src/evaluation/types.ts, src/evaluation/core.ts and src/evaluation/report.ts with tests in tests/harness-eval-core.test.ts. Define versioned suite, scenario, repetition, HarnessEvalRun and baseline/candidate comparison types. The core must parse and validate argv-array command scenarios without shell strings, require every run to bind an exact clean Git starting commit, run injected executors with fixed cwd, per-command timeout and bounded retained output, support configured repetitions, scenario pass only when all repetitions match an explicit zero/nonzero expectation, record wall time and null/unknown request/token/cache/cost/human-intervention observations with missing reasons, compute pass rate and flipped scenario ids against a baseline, and render deterministic JSON plus bounded Markdown reports. Fail closed on malformed suites, unsafe ids/paths, empty scenarios/commands, invalid timeout/repetition bounds, duplicate ids or malformed baseline reports. A comparison must require compatible suite id/version and repetition counts but must allow different exact baseline and candidate Git commits so a real Harness change can be evaluated. Do not add CLI wiring, call a real model or write outside the task-owned output directory supplied by the caller.
nonGoals: Do not compare paid model quality.
Do not add a CLI command or package script in this task.
Do not use an LLM judge.
Do not treat unavailable metrics as zero.
deliverables: A versioned deterministic eval engine with repeated scenario execution.
Baseline/candidate comparison with pass rate, flips, durations and explicit missing metrics.
JSON and bounded Markdown report generation.
forbidden: Do not invoke a paid provider in v0 core tests.
Do not hide unavailable measurements behind zero or an average.
Do not accept a one-run pass as a flake-rate claim.

goals: Integrate the accepted controller EvidenceBundle v0 module into the Supervisor CLI without changing RunManifest task authority. In src/supervisor/cli.ts, generate the evidence bundle after the Worker batch has returned terminal path, cleanup, boundary and cost facts; expose a bounded evidence status projection and a supervisor evidence command that reads or regenerates .cliyard/evidence/<runId>.json. A completed-run resume must also repair a missing bundle before returning. Missing or invalid evidence must be reported as degraded and must not be converted into success. Add tests in tests/supervisor-evidence-bundle.test.ts and update tests/supervisor-cli.test.ts to cover completed and blocked terminal runs, automatic bundle creation, evidence status JSON/human output, missing/invalid bundle reporting, explicit regeneration without RunManifest mutation, completed resume repair, path/process/boundary/cost inclusion and unsupported running inputs. Preserve existing status/start/resume/stop output and all current behavior.
nonGoals: Do not modify the EvidenceBundle core or eval engine.
Do not mutate task verdicts or RunManifest acceptance.
Do not auto-merge or push accepted work.
Do not turn status into a state-changing command.
deliverables: Automatic final EvidenceBundle generation for terminal runs.
Read-only degraded status plus explicit regeneration command.
Completed-run resume evidence repair and integration tests.
forbidden: Do not rewrite a RunManifest to claim evidence exists.
Do not hide missing evidence as clean.

goals: Integrate Harness Eval v0 into the CLI and add the required deterministic scenario suite. Add src/evaluation/cli.ts and src/evaluation/scenarios.ts, add a real context-reload handoff helper in src/evaluation/handoff.ts, wire the top-level src/cli.ts and package.json script, and add examples/harness-eval/suite.json. Implement cliyard eval run --suite <path> --label <id> --repetitions <n> --out <dir> --json and eval compare --baseline <run.json> --candidate <run.json> --out <path> --json using the accepted eval core. Execute argv arrays without a shell, bounded timeout/output and fixed cwd; reject dirty/wrong commits and unsafe paths. The suite must name six scenarios: normal-work, high-fanout-process-tree, verifier-timeout-and-extension, controller-sigkill-recovery, path-escape and context-reload-handoff. Reuse real existing focused tests where appropriate and add tests/harness-eval-cli.test.ts plus tests/harness-eval-handoff.test.ts; the handoff test must start a fresh process that reads only a terminal RunManifest/EvidenceBundle fixture and reconstructs the next action. Tests must cover malformed suites, command timeout, expected nonzero, repetition failures, unavailable metrics, flipped scenarios in compare, unsafe ids/paths and bounded secrets-free output. Do not add paid provider calls or change Supervisor behavior.
nonGoals: Do not call paid models.
Do not auto-change prompts or skills.
Do not add dynamic routing, daemon or parallel admission.
Do not claim provider-level compaction.
verifyCommands: npm run harness-eval -- run --suite examples/harness-eval/suite.json --label smoke --repetitions 1 --out .cliyard/evals/smoke --json
deliverables: A working argv-only eval run/compare CLI and package script.
Six bounded local scenarios, including a fresh-process handoff reconstruction.
Machine-readable and Markdown reports with explicit missing metrics and flipped scenarios.
forbidden: Do not run commands through a shell.
Do not treat unavailable provider metrics as zero.
Do not add a paid eval path to the critical tests.

goals: Run the accepted Harness Eval v0 CLI twice at the exact task base to validate repeatability, then compare the two named runs and add docs/evidence/HARNESS_EVAL_V0.md with only observed facts. Use at least two repetitions per scenario and record each scenario's repetition outcomes, pass rate, flipped scenarios, durations, the known deadline-extension flake if it appears, missing request/token/cache/cost/human-intervention measurements, exact commands, exact base commit, report paths and final focused/build/full results. Also record how a fresh process reconstructs the next action from the EvidenceBundle handoff fixture. Clearly state that baseline and candidate here are same-code repeatability checks, not a Harness improvement or provider-quality comparison. Preserve non-goals: no paid model eval, LLM judge, dynamic routing, daemon, OS sandbox, automatic prompt optimization, merge or push. Do not modify source, tests, Plan or contracts.
nonGoals: Do not modify source or tests.
Do not claim a Harness improvement from same-code runs.
Do not hide a flaky scenario behind aggregate pass rate.
Do not claim provider-level compaction or paid-model quality.
